answer: Give every agent a beacon ticket: a fresh random challenge issued by the network, like a comet streaking through a nebula of pending identities. To claim an island of trust, each agent must burn real compute solving a puzzle bound to that ticket inside a ten-minute window, and stake 20 POA that is slashed if the same ticket is ever reused. A Sybil farm must pay full compute plus stake for every fake, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand puzzles and 20,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once.
